payload.entry: LAND AUDIT / FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (2026-11-26): Read this epic, every child and every note (.1 notes 1-2, .2 notes 1-4, .3 note 1), source phase bob-cli-q5.7, both linked plans, and decisions:mac-capture-is-a-thin-client, decisions:idle-capture-shows-ledger-agenda, decisions:today-is-read-from-the-ledger. Reviewed Mac commits c4a30591, e387187f, e4a97f52, a4a7020d and current models, fixtures, editor span mapping, presentation/folding/measurement/views, process client, app/store lifecycle, policy/scheduler, and tests. The four agenda-snoozed fixtures exactly match bob-cli. All additive decoding, budget/numbering separation, first-fold summary, accent expiry, +5-second timing, and non-cancelling writer wiring are present. Earlier compile/layout/countdown concerns are resolved: GitHub run 45847440694 succeeded in lint/build/test/bundle/signature/launch/install; fetched snapshot f923059807e9efa942476d1a51bb7388d26c9efe and current Mac a4a7020d have identical tree b52b21dbc584c2217c5613fe0aa06f9c4dbb8189. Phase .3 reports 2837 portable tests (one skip), scratch bundle/typecheck, and docs-check; this lander independently confirmed CI steps and tree equality, not a fresh full-suite run. Integration: Mac master/origin master a4a7020d; bob-cli master/origin master 4dd787bc. Non-epic Mac commits since first epic commit are aa233750/38dc0dee, and creation-time drift also includes 6ea5b8f6; bob-cli drift is 4dd787bc. They repair true-case drawer fixtures/assertions, do not add competing agenda/wake consumers, and need no extra feature integration. PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP from bob-cli-q5.7.1.2 note 1 (CapturePlaceMenuPresentationTests.testEmptyQueryOpensWithOnThisTaskAndRecentGroupsAndNothingSelected: 3 vs 4 weeks ago) DECLINED AS RESOLVED: aa233750 replaces the real-date literal with Bob-returned detail and stable prefix/suffix, 38dc0dee unwraps optional detail; both are in the verified green tree. Used sase_new_task; searched CI then all task types across statuses, swept last-week task beads, inspected active epic scopes and bob-cli-ph. No duplicate task needed and no defect remains to attach as active work. The only proposed follow-up is fully triaged. No --epic-symbol entries for bob-cli-q5.7.1. Epic remains open for scheduler/summary repairs described in the next note.

REMAINING EPIC WORK: (1) CaptureSnoozeWakePolicy.settle clears target/retryDeadline on nil or a new target, but SnoozeWakeScheduler.refreshScheduleFromSnapshot re-applies its retained old snapshot on every timer/lifecycle callback. Executed the unmodified production CaptureSnoozeWake.swift with minimal DTO stubs: update old 2026-08-28T09:00:00-04:00 at target+5; beginAttempt true; settle nil (and separately 19:00 target) at +1; update same snapshot at +2; beginAttempt returned true in both cases. This violates retirement and the 60-second retry floor. (2) finishWakeAttempt treats deferred/skipped exactly like woke; nil next_wake_at disarms, and byte-identical CaptureAgendaStore refresh publishes nothing, so due work can lose all retries. Real bob-cli wake_report (src/native/snooze/cli.rs) computes next_wake_at from a prospective postimage when the plan has woken rows even on deferred/skipped paths, so these replies do not prove a write happened. Preserve due retries for non-writing outcomes until fresh agenda facts retire them. Also guard in-flight results across day/executable changes and pin unsupported-command cache entries to the identity that launched the process (current snoozeWake catch writes identityToken again). Add realistic fake-Bob/policy regressions; existing tests only cover deferred with the SAME non-null target. (3) CaptureAgendaRowView .snoozedSummary passes literal "alarm " into CaptureAgendaChipButton, whose body is Text(text). Replace it with the intended SF Symbol alarm and recheck rendered heights/light-dark evidence. These are caused by this epic, not standalone follow-ups. A medium tale will finish these changes, required compilation/CI, then close this epic and parent phase bob-cli-q5.7 normally; it must leave outer epic bob-cli-q5 open.
